title: A close runner refuses on the run's first message
what: Every workflow agent sees the message that started the run as the owner's only words. wf_a74e8dbc-fb9 started in the turn of the owner's question «Можем ли мы начать выполнять изменения параллельно ?» (the go, "a", came in a later turn the run did not see); 1 of 3 close runners (Haiku) refused `relay queue done` on principle 9; the doctor-exit item stayed open for the front.
why: Closing an item after open 0 is a recorded rule, not the agent's call; a random refusal (1 of 3) leaves items open and the front closes them by hand.
failing_case: A cycle run started in the turn of an owner question: a close runner may refuse to close a checked item.
pass_cases: cycle.js tells the close step that closing is the cycle's rule after open 0, whatever the triggering message, or closes by a script step without an agent's judgement.
A run started on a go closes all its items, as now.
